headline: Moderna and Merck's mRNA Cancer Vaccine Shows Major Promise
meta_description: A new mRNA cancer vaccine developed by Moderna and Merck reduced death and recurrence rates by 42%, offering hope for cancer patients.
summary_short: Moderna and Merck announce their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death and recurrence by 42%, marking a significant breakthrough in cancer treatment.
body:
Moderna and Merck have announced that their mRNA cancer vaccine reduced death and recurrence rates by 42%—a substantial breakthrough in oncology.

The collaboration between the two pharmaceutical companies represents a major step forward in harnessing messenger RNA technology for cancer treatment. Rather than preventing disease, this vaccine works by training the immune system to recognize and fight existing cancer cells, offering a new approach to improving patient outcomes.

The 42% reduction in death and recurrence rates signals real progress in the fight against cancer, potentially extending and improving lives for patients who receive this treatment alongside standard therapies.
quick_facts: Moderna and Merck developed an mRNA cancer vaccine
The vaccine reduced death and recurrence by 42%
New approach uses mRNA to train the immune system
